buy_title: The three heated throws to order, and the label check before the first night
buy_total: The button shows today's price; as an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases, and it never changes what you pay.

cards.name: Sunbeam Royal Luxe Microplush Heated Throw (50 x 60 in)
cards.price: About $26 at Walmart in a search snippet we could not date; everyday Sunbeam throw prices run about $24–$30. The button shows today's price.
cards.buy_if: you want one person warm on the sofa, from a brand with no 2025–2026 recall, and you will read the label first.
cards.skip_if: you want to warm a bed (look at a full-size blanket), or you need it for an infant, an immobile person or someone who cannot feel heat.
cards.owners: Walmart review summaries (undated) mention controllers that blink or show an F2 fault and stop heating; praise is for quick warm-up and softness.

buy.pick: The Royal Luxe Microplush 50×60 (4 heat settings, 4-hour auto-off, 5-year limited warranty per listings)
buy.check: Sold by Sunbeam or the store itself; the title says Royal Luxe, 50×60; wattage and the UL or ETL mark are unconfirmed, so read the label; the controller must come off for washing
buy.label: See today's price

cards.name: Bedsure Heated Blanket Electric Throw (50 x 60 in)
cards.badge: The cheaper pick · 2023 recall on other models
cards.price: About $27–$32 at Walmart (search snippets, undated; $32 on Oct 1, 2026 in our earlier check). The button shows today's price.
cards.buy_if: you want the lowest price for a sofa throw and will check the label against the 2023 recall list.
cards.skip_if: you want a brand with no recall history at all, or a guaranteed 8-hour auto-off (a Walmart listing for this size says 3 hours).
cards.owners: Our Bedsure review covers owner reports; we found no brand-specific non-Amazon complaint this time.

buy.pick: The 50×60 throw; read the auto-off in the title (3, 8 or 10 hours depending on the version)
buy.check: ETL mark in the title; compare the label with the seven model numbers recalled in March 2023 (BS-HB5060 is on the list); sold by Bedsure
buy.label: See today's price

cards.name: Beautyrest Marselle Oversized Faux Fur Heated Throw (50 x 70 in)
cards.badge: The bigger pick · room for two
cards.price: About $67 on sale at Target in a search snippet we could not date; also at Kohl's. The button shows today's price.
cards.buy_if: you want a bigger throw for a long sofa or two people and can live with a 2-hour auto-off.
cards.skip_if: you want a long auto-off timer, or a confirmed wash-and-dry rating (we could not confirm wattage, listing mark or washability).
cards.owners: We found no usable long-term owner reports; the few Walmart pages we saw for Beautyrest throws had reviews flagged as promotional.

buy.pick: The Marselle 50×70 faux fur throw (not the 50×60 Beautyrest fleece)
buy.check: Sold by Beautyrest or the store; 50×70 in the title; read the listing mark and the wash instructions on the label before use
buy.label: See today's price
